{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.42

|gr1= Revive

|descr= Handles healing of unit. Unit gets fully healed after 10 seconds if current damage is smaller than initial damage, e.g. a medic healed the unit.

|s1= [unit] call [[BIS_fnc_reviveEhHandleHeal]]

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - unit to be healed

|r1= [[Boolean]] - if revive is enabled for given unit it always returns [[false]], if revive is disabled it returns [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>[BIS_unit] call BIS_fnc_reviveEhHandleHeal;
</sqf>
